chunks: From him, from al-Ḥasan ibn ʿAlī ibn Faḍḍāl, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn Bukayr, from Muḥammad ibn Muslim, from Abī Jaʿfar عليه السلام, who said:
Qunūt is in every two rakʿahs of supererogatory prayer or obligatory prayer.
Al-Ḥasan said: And ʿAbd Allāh ibn Bukayr informed me, from Zurārah, from Abī Jaʿfar عليه السلام, who said: Qunūt is in all prayers.
Muḥammad ibn Muslim said: So I mentioned that to Abī ʿAbd Allāh عليه السلام, and he said: As for that in which there is no doubt, it is that in which the recitation is made aloud.
ai.seo_question: In which prayers is qunūt performed according to Imam al-Bāqir and Imam al-Ṣādiq عليهما السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith discusses the sunnah of qunūt in salat, stating that it is performed in every two rakʿahs of voluntary and obligatory prayers. It further reports that qunūt applies to all prayers, while specifying with certainty those prayers in which the recitation is audible.
